runtimeProfile.name: identity_go_gateway_pgbouncer_live_320
runtimeProfile.executionEnvironment: Local Go gateway with Docker identity PgBouncer profile

metrics.name: benchmark.concurrency
metrics.interpretation: Current strong local run used operations greater than concurrency and completed with zero phase errors.

metrics.name: passwordLogin.p95_ms
metrics.interpretation: Login write path completed without errors at 320 concurrent clients, but tuned database capacity did not improve login tail latency.

metrics.name: refreshRotation.p95_ms
metrics.interpretation: Refresh rotation remains the heavier write path but completed without errors.

metrics.name: revokeCycle.p95_ms
metrics.interpretation: Revoke cycle is the slowest mixed write/read phase and the first path to watch in higher-load tuning.

metrics.name: phase.errors
metrics.interpretation: All benchmark phases completed without reported errors.

entries.rollbackOrNextAction: Keep 320 as the current repeatable local pass point; the next performance slice should test multi-worker or load-balanced gateway ingress.

runtimeProfile.executionEnvironment: Local Go gateway with Docker identity PgBouncer profile

metrics.name: probe.concurrency
metrics.interpretation: The first current local limit probe above the 320 pass point failed during the login write phase.

metrics.name: passwordLogin.errors
metrics.interpretation: The tuned database profile still reported connection refusals in the login phase.

metrics.name: gateway.exit_code_before_cleanup
metrics.interpretation: The runner observed no gateway process exit before cleanup, pointing to accept/connect pressure rather than a captured gateway crash.

entries.rollbackOrNextAction: Treat this as a local single-gateway accept/connect limit because the tuned database profile did not move the 360-concurrency failure point.
